verdict.rationale: Limitless has a documented Developer API with API keys. It covers listing, searching, filtering, fetching and deleting Lifelogs, downloading raw Pendant audio, and listing and deleting Ask AI chats, plus an MCP server for search and ask. That is substantial programmatic access to core data, but most of it is read or delete only. The docs never claim UI parity, and bulk export and delete-all are described as features done 'within the app' rather than via the API. missing for 10: creating or sending Ask AI chats via the API, managing scheduled prompts via the API, editing or starring Lifelogs via the API, settings and account management via the API, API-level bulk export, and independent confirmation of feature parity with the UI.
